hints.title: Arbitrary Orientation Rectangle Property
hints.text: A rectangle in the plane has opposite diagonals that share the exact same midpoint and possess identical squared lengths.

hints.title: Diagonal Pair Grouping
hints.text: For each pair of points, compute their midpoint and squared Euclidean distance. Group pairs by the combined signature (center_x, center_y, distance_squared).

hints.title: Area Computation on Co-Diagonal Pairs
hints.text: For any two pairs (p1, p2) and (p3, p4) sharing the same diagonal center and length, they form a rectangle. Area is Euclidean distance(p1, p3) * Euclidean distance(p1, p4). Minimize area over all such pairs.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
import math
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def minAreaFreeRect(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> float:
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        n = len(points)
        for i in range(n):
            x1, y1 = points[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                x2, y2 = points[j]
                cx, cy = x1 + x2, y1 + y2
                d2 = (x1 - x2) ** 2 + (y1 - y2) ** 2
                groups[(cx, cy, d2)].append((x1, y1, x2, y2))
        min_area = float("inf")
        for pairs in groups.values():
            m = len(pairs)
            for i in range(m):
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = pairs[i]
                for j in range(i + 1, m):
                    x3, y3, _, _ = pairs[j]
                    side1 = math.hypot(x1 - x3, y1 - y3)
                    side2 = math.hypot(x2 - x3, y2 - y3)
                    min_area = min(min_area, side1 * side2)
        return min_area if min_area != float("inf") else 0.0
```

variables: K: number of pairs sharing identical midpoint and diagonal length
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 4-point combinations takes O(N^4) which times out for N = 50.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping diagonal segments by center and length checks only valid rectangular configurations, running in sub-quadratic expected time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize geometric properties of rectangle diagonals: congruent and bisecting each other.
complexity.notes: Floating point coordinates should be represented with high precision or multiplied by 2 to keep integers.

import math
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def minAreaFreeRect(self, points: list[list[int]]) -> float:
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        n = len(points)
        for i in range(n):
            x1, y1 = points[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                x2, y2 = points[j]
                cx, cy = x1 + x2, y1 + y2
                d2 = (x1 - x2) ** 2 + (y1 - y2) ** 2
                groups[(cx, cy, d2)].append((x1, y1, x2, y2))
        min_area = float("inf")
        for pairs in groups.values():
            m = len(pairs)
            for i in range(m):
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = pairs[i]
                for j in range(i + 1, m):
                    x3, y3, _, _ = pairs[j]
                    side1 = math.hypot(x1 - x3, y1 - y3)
                    side2 = math.hypot(x2 - x3, y2 - y3)
                    min_area = min(min_area, side1 * side2)
        return min_area if min_area != float("inf") else 0.0
